cause_sensitive_definition.forward_matching: event profile plus mapped enabling witness
cause_sensitive_definition.backward_matching: remove causal-maximal realization along the existing realization map

experiment_A_surface_vs_cause_sensitive.finding: Surface equality passes because the same events occurred, but governed cause-sensitive equivalence rejects the two different source histories.

experiment_B_profile_relative_cause_quot.finding: If the source events are deliberately placed in the same profile/equivalence class, the cause histories can be matched by swapping a and b.

main_result: The CauseMode axis is non-redundant: two histories can be identical after surface-cause forgetting but fail cause-sensitive equivalence.
warning: Finite General-CEES toy checker; not yet a theorem that CBHHP_k coincides with any standard named equivalence.
